findings.evidence: Sidebar avatars are <button draggable> and filled slots are <li draggable> whose surface is mostly an inner <button>. Chromium (incl. Tauri WebView2) starts HTML5 drags from buttons, but Firefox has historically not started drags from <button> elements. jsdom tests dispatch dragstart/drop directly, so they cannot show this. No real-browser drag check was possible in this review (the characters page needs a signed-in account).
findings.impact: Low: if the browser does not start the drag, Firefox users cannot drag avatars or slots, but slot-then-avatar click placement, arrow buttons and remove buttons still cover every operation, so no function is lost.
findings.recommendation: Non-blocking. Verify drag in current Firefox and Chromium on the dev server. If Firefox does not drag, make the draggable element a non-button wrapper (e.g. a div/li with draggable and role/keyboard handled by the inner button) or start the drag from a dedicated handle. Track as a follow-up.
